prompt: Which statements about scoping secrets and variables are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: The three scopes apply to secrets and variables alike, with the closest scope winning. But organization-level values must be explicitly granted to repositories, and secrets are write-only — you can list names, never read values back.

options.text: Both exist at organization, repository, and environment level
Environment-scoped values reach only jobs that reference that environment
Organization secrets are automatically available to every repository in the organization
Variables are the right home for non-sensitive configuration like image names
A secret’s value can be read back later through the REST API
